info.name: MonkoraEdge Core Auth API
info.description:
Enterprise OAuth 2.1 Authentication Server — MonkoraEdge Core Auth API.

Covers: Auth, OAuth2/OIDC (Authorization Code+PKCE, Client Credentials, Refresh Token, Device Grant), PAR (RFC 9126), Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591), Introspection (RFC 7662), Revocation (RFC 7009), DPoP (RFC 9449), UserInfo, End-Session, SAML 2.0 SP, Social Login, Magic Link, Passkeys (WebAuthn/FIDO2), 2FA (TOTP/SMS/EMAIL), IAM (Tenants, Users, Roles, Permissions, Scopes, Clients, API Keys, Agreements, Providers, Webhooks).

**CRITICAL — Authorize endpoint:** All parameters MUST be snake_case per RFC 6749 (`response_type`, `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, `code_challenge`, `code_challenge_method`). The pre-request script auto-generates PKCE verifier/challenge (S256).

**client_credentials grant:** OIDC scopes (openid, profile, email, phone, offline_access) are rejected. Use resource-level scopes only (e.g. `api.access`).

**2FA verify:** Use `twoFactorToken` from the Login response challenge, NOT userId.

Updated: 2026-06-09

Compatibility refresh endpoint. Prefer POST /oauth2/token with grant_type=refresh_token.
Complete 2FA login using `twoFactorToken` from the Login challenge response (auto-saved by Login test script). Do NOT supply userId — the server resolves identity from twoFactorToken.
Returns authorization URL for the external provider. Redirect the user's browser there. providerCode examples: google, facebook, apple, line, github.
Handle the provider callback. Exchanges provider code for local access + refresh tokens.
Request a passwordless magic-link. Always returns 200 — link is sent only if email is registered.

request.description:
Start Authorization Code + PKCE flow.

**Pre-request script** auto-generates codeVerifier/codeChallenge (S256) + random state/nonce.

**BUG FIX:** Parameters are snake_case per RFC 6749 (`response_type`, `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, `code_challenge`, `code_challenge_method`). Using camelCase would silently fail.

On success the server redirects to `redirect_uri?code=XXX&state=YYY` — copy the code value into `{{authorizationCode}}`.
Silent authorization check — no UI interaction. Returns `login_required` or `interaction_required` when session is missing.
Submit user consent decision. Origin and Referer headers satisfy the same-origin CSRF guard.
Exchange authorization code for tokens. `code_verifier` must match the `code_challenge` sent in the authorize step. `refresh_token` is returned only when `offline_access` scope was granted.
Rotate refresh token. Old token is immediately invalidated. Family-based reuse detection cascades revocation on replay.
Machine-to-machine grant. OIDC scopes (openid, profile, email, phone, offline_access) are **rejected** — use resource-level scopes only.
`client_secret_basic` auth method. Pre-request script builds the Basic header.
RFC 7009 token revocation. Always returns 200 for authenticated requests.
Validate token and retrieve metadata. Returns `{active:true, ...claims}` or `{active:false}`.
RP-initiated logout. Redirects to `post_logout_redirect_uri` only when it matches a registered URI.
RFC 9126 PAR. POST authorization parameters to receive a short-lived `request_uri`. Then pass the `request_uri` to /authorize instead of inline parameters.
Use the request_uri from the PAR response to start the authorize flow. Replace the placeholder with the actual `urn:ietf:params:oauth:request_uri:...` value.
RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration. No auth required. `client_secret` returned only once.
Step 1: Get device_code + user_code. User navigates to verification_uri and enters user_code. Device polls the token endpoint until approved.
Step 2: Authenticated user approves the device login. userCode auto-saved from the Device Authorization request.
Step 3: Device polls until approved. Errors: `authorization_pending` (retry), `slow_down`, `expired_token`, `access_denied`.

Returns `{challengeId, options}`. Pass `options` to `navigator.credentials.create()` in the browser, then send attestation response to the Complete endpoint.
Public — no auth required. Returns `{challengeId, options}`. Optionally provide email as a login hint.
